description: Machine-checked routing for immutable verifier evidence, the retained Milestone 7A release foundation, and the authorized Milestone 7B OIV-first accessibility/performance scope. The status command remains the source of live Git/report state.

activeScope.name: Milestone 7B — OIV-first accessibility and mobile performance

requirements.intent: Route accepted Milestone 6 history and the active Milestone 7 release matrix without treating summaries as authority.
Keep eight destinations in stable order with 44px targets, visible narrow-screen overflow affordance, active-tab reveal, and no duplicate global routing.
Prove normal, 320px boundary, text-scale, keyboard/touch, resize and reload navigation behavior through the pinned browser.
Maintain a concrete commercial-release acceptance matrix for the remaining balance, accessibility, performance, writing, audio, save, localization and packaging work.
Close the WebKit browser gap at 320x693 and 393x742 with pinned, reduced-motion, text-scale, reload/offline, interaction, geometry, and error evidence.
Close native VoiceOver and TalkBack evidence on the available iOS Simulator and unlocked USB Android, including names, active state, narrow reveal, first action, and lifecycle results.

Produce five-run clean-install mobile-performance measurements with LCP/INP/CLS budgets, same-device baseline deltas, Worker 1x/64x cost, memory, offline startup, and physical battery/thermal evidence.
Keep M7B device/browser matrix, Rule of Three, artifact manifest, cleanup, and infrastructure BLOCKED behavior independently verifiable without silently substituting Chromium evidence.
